title: Spending upgrade money sensibly
target: How to decide between the upgrades available to a R.E.P.O. crew when each one is an item with its own purpose rather than a general improvement.
version: 0.4.0, read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: An upgrade stand in the shop
A crew that agrees on what is missing

steps.do: Work out what the crew is actually short of before buying.
steps.because: the save records a name for every upgrade the game knows about (upgradesInfo)

steps.do: Prefer the upgrades that help the whole crew over the ones that help one player once.
steps.because: an upgrade records whether it improves the player or the gear (isPlayerUpgrade)

steps.do: Put what you buy where it will be used rather than leaving it loose.
steps.because: upgrades are placed on a stand and cached with their position (CachedUpgrade)

steps.do: Check the charging and battery situation before buying more battery gear.
steps.because: batteries and charging are their own items (ChargingStation)

steps.do: Buy nothing on a run you have not yet extracted from.
steps.because: the shop is where upgrades are applied between runs (ShopRadio)

commonMistakes: Buying an upgrade nobody in the crew will use.
Spending everything and leaving nothing for the next run.
Leaving a bought upgrade in the van.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
